propositions: Multiple test scanners independently parse the same source trees (tests/ and src/rebar), incurring redundant AST parsing that accounts for 75-80% of scan cost and dominates test gate duration.

A shared process-global memoized parse cache via functools.cache on resolved root paths allows the first scanner per xdist worker to parse and all subsequent scanners to reuse results, eliminating redundancy.
The cached helper standardizes parse invocation with filename=str(path) and strict UTF-8 encoding to ensure byte-identical results to prior scanner behavior and preserve SyntaxError metadata.

Scanners over committed src/rebar and tests trees are migrated to the shared helper, while scanners invoked on synthetic/tmp_path roots with potentially unparseable files are excluded to preserve error-handling behavior.
